# Siren Training

> > Siren Training delivers HSE-certified first aid, mental health, and fire safety courses across London with flexible delivery options and expert instruction.

Siren Training is a London-based training provider specializing in workplace safety and health certifications. They offer daily courses in first aid, CPR, mental health first aid, paediatric training, and fire safety, with multiple London venues including Old Street, Victoria, and Charing Cross. The company serves corporate clients, childcare professionals, and sports organizations with both in-person and blended learning options.

## Key Topics

- First Aid at Work
- Mental Health First Aid (MHFA)
- Paediatric First Aid
- CPR Training
- Fire Safety
- Workplace Safety
- OFSTED Certification
- In-house Training
- London Venues
- Blended Learning
- Emergency Response
- Childcare Training
- Fire Marshal Training
- Course Requalification

## Core First Aid Courses

- [First Aid Courses | CPR Training in London - Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses): HSE-certified first aid and CPR courses in London with flexible delivery options
- [Emergency First Aid at Work - Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/1-day-emergency-first-aid-at-work): One-day Emergency First Aid at Work (EFAW) course at Old Street, Victoria, Charing Cross
- [First Aid at Work Course (3 day) | Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/3-day-first-aid-course): Comprehensive 3-day First Aid at Work course for high-risk environments
- [Blended First Aid at Work Training | Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/blended-learning-first-aid-at-work): Blended e-learning and face-to-face First Aid at Work training in London
- [First Aid at Work Refresher Training | Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/first-aid-at-work-requalification): Two-day First Aid at Work requalification refresher for expired certifications
- [Sports First Aid Course | Sports EFAW](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/sports-emergency-first-aid-at-work): Sports-focused EFAW course for coaches and sports leaders, UKA-aligned training

## Paediatric & Childcare Training

- [Paediatric (Baby) First Aid Course| Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/paediatric-first-aid-course): OFSTED-approved 12-hour paediatric first aid course for childcare professionals
- [Paediatric First Aid | 12 Hour Course | OFSTED Recognised](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/2-days-paediatric-first-aid): OFSTED-recognised 12-hour blended paediatric first aid with online and instructor training
- [6 hour Paediatric First Aid Course | First Aid Training | Child CPR](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/1-day-paediatric-first-aid): Six-hour paediatric first aid course covering child CPR and emergency response

## Mental Health & Wellbeing

- [Mental Health First Aid Courses - Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/mental-health-first-aid): MHFA England certified mental health first aid courses online and in-person in London
- [Mental Health First Aid Refresher - MHFA Refresher Course](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/mental-health-first-aid-refresher): MHFA refresher course with MHFAider support app access for London and Birmingham
- [Mental Health Skills for Managers Training | Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/mental-health-skills-for-managers-training): MHFA-aligned mental health skills training for managers to build healthy workplaces

## Fire Safety & Compliance

- [Fire Marshal Training by Firefighters - Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/first-aid-courses/fire-marshal-training): CPD-certified fire marshal training delivered by London firefighters, half-day course
- [Fire Extinguisher Training | Fire Safety London - Siren Training](https://www.sirentraining.co.uk/fire-safety/fire-extinguisher-training): Practical fire extinguisher training for workplace fire safety compliance
- [Fire Risk Assessment London | Siren Training](http://www.sirentraining.co.uk/fire-risk-assessment): Fire Risk Assessment service in London with 24-hour report delivery and price matching
